description: This file implements a COCO evaluation class for object detection, segmentation, and keypoints, including methods for preparing results, merging evaluations, and running evaluation metrics, primarily used in distributed training or evaluation scenarios.

classes.name: CocoEvaluator
classes.description: Class for evaluating COCO object detection, segmentation, and keypoints results in distributed mode.

methods.name: convert_to_xywh
methods.description: Converts bounding boxes from (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) to (x, y, width, height) format.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges evaluation results and image IDs from multiple processes.

methods.name: create_common_coco_eval
methods.description: Creates a unified COCO evaluation object from merged results.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Runs per-image evaluation on given images and stores results.
